semantic_boundaries: Models and emits the RTF 1.9.1 positioned paragraph controls with bounded numeric validation; it does not render, paginate, or calculate layout.

Table cells retain paragraph text spans and effective frames, including inherited controls before intbl and nested itap levels; every paragraph in a positioned table row must carry the same effective frame controls, as required by the local RTF grammar.
wrapdefault alone remains the existing paragraph line-breaking default and does not manufacture a positioned frame from common native default formatting.

CellParagraph metadata distinguishes in-paragraph line breaks from paragraph boundaries: preserved or applicable in-range newlines emit line, while paragraph-boundary metadata emits par. Newly unmatched newlines use the existing text-edit paragraph-break semantics.

Paragraph-layout transactions cover direct paragraph properties and refuse style-dependent effective-property edits; table-containing and unsupported dependent positioned structures are refused before publication.

Source-aware body layout publication preserves accepted opaque nodes and zero-width bookmark/page/column/soft-break metadata within the admitted source span; unsupported dependent structure, rendering, arbitrary table mutation, and native-producer acceptance remain outside this batch.
The existing flat table cell text API records bounded paragraph spans and frame metadata but does not claim a full table layout engine.
